name: mistlib
description: A P2P networking library for sharing information with nearby peers in virtual spaces. It replaces MistNet, which only worked in Unity, and can be used from web apps or as a DLL. In development

name: Linkai Online
description: A block sandbox where you can build, craft and create spells in a forest. I first built it in Unity and am now remaking it as a web game. In development

name: MISTL
description: A Rust daemon CLI that runs on mistlib and packages tik-choco features in one binary. In development
